description: Search the swisscovery union catalogue of Swiss academic libraries by keywords, title, author, subject or ISBN (fields are combined with AND). Returns bibliographic records (title, creators, publisher, year, ISBN, subjects, online links) and a swisscovery link to check holdings/availability. Example: {author: 'Spyri', title: 'Heidi'}, {subject: 'Gletscher', keywords: 'Klimawandel'}.
name: search_library_catalogue
title: Search Swiss academic libraries (swisscovery)
